tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: Catalogue of the editable SVG maps on tuper.app/maps: for each map the place (country, US state, continent), unit (counties, states, provinces...), number of regions, labelled or blank, free or paid with price, page URL and buy link. Filter by access (free/paid) or kind (us/country/world).

tools.name: find_map
tools.description: Find maps by place or region name, e.g. "Texas", "Japan", "Ontario", "Cook County", "Europe". Matches map titles and the names of every region inside each map, and returns the matching maps (free first) with the regions that matched.

tools.name: get_free_map
tools.description: Returns the SVG source of one free map (blank world, blank US states, blank US counties, blank maps of countries and continents, labelled Switzerland cantons) with its region names. Every region is one <path> with id and data-name, ready to recolour as a choropleth. Free for any use. Pass id from li
